CREATE POLICY customer_account_manager_comms ON sales.customer_communications FOR SELECT USING (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'account_manager' AND account_manager_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::int AND app_now()::time BETWEEN '09:00'::time AND '18:00'::time AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM app_now()::date) BETWEEN 1 AND 5);
